<!--
Purpose: Read the seven raw CSV files, confirm they loaded as expected, and check
         every categorical code against data_raw/codebook.md.
Reads:   data_raw/
Writes:  nothing (inspection only)
Packages: here, tidyverse, knitr
-->

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
set.seed(20261016)
raw_dir <- here::here("data_raw")
```

All data are **synthetic**. See `data_raw/codebook.md` for the codebook; the built-in data issues are listed in `answer_key/ground_truth.md`.

## Read raw files

ZIP codes are stored as text because some carry a ZIP+4 suffix (`63106-1234`). Reading them as numbers would silently turn those into `NA`.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
read_raw <- function(file, ...) {
  readr::read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, file), show_col_types = FALSE, ...)
}

core     <- read_raw("dese_student_core.csv", col_types = cols(zipcode = col_character()))
test     <- read_raw("dese_student_test.csv")
enroll   <- read_raw("dese_student_enroll.csv")
disc     <- read_raw("dese_student_discipline.csv")
schools  <- read_raw("building_list.csv", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
sch_demo <- read_raw("dese_school_demo.csv")
acs      <- read_raw("acs_zip_panel_mock.csv")
```

## File dimensions

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
files <- list(core = core, test = test, enroll = enroll, discipline = disc,
              building_list = schools, school_demo = sch_demo, acs = acs)

tibble(
  file     = names(files),
  rows     = map_int(files, nrow),
  columns  = map_int(files, ncol),
  students = map_int(files, ~ if ("research_id" %in% names(.x)) n_distinct(.x$research_id) else NA_integer_),
  years    = map_chr(files, function(d) {
    yr <- intersect(c("currentschoolyear", "year"), names(d))
    if (length(yr)) paste(range(d[[yr[1]]]), collapse = "–") else "—"
  })
) %>% kable()
```

## Column types

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
map_dfr(files, ~ tibble(column = names(.x), type = map_chr(.x, ~ class(.x)[1])), .id = "file") %>%
  group_by(file, type) %>%
  summarise(columns = paste(column, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable()
```

## Check codes against the codebook

Every categorical value should appear in the codebook. Any row with `in_codebook = FALSE` needs a decision before cleaning.

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
codebook <- list(
  gender            = 1:2,
  raceethnicity     = 1:5,
  studentgradelevel = 0:12,
  lunchstatus       = 0:2,
  lepell            = 0:1,
  iepdisability     = 0:6,
  seq               = 1:2
)

core_codes <- imap_dfr(codebook, function(valid, var) {
  core %>% count(value = .data[[var]]) %>% mutate(variable = var, in_codebook = value %in% valid)
})
disc_codes <- disc %>% count(value = disciplineremoval) %>%
  mutate(variable = "disciplineremoval", in_codebook = value %in% 1:4)

bind_rows(core_codes, disc_codes) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(values = paste(sort(value), collapse = ", "),
            all_in_codebook = all(in_codebook), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable()
```

## First look at the messiness

Counts only — no individual records are printed.

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
tibble(
  check = c("Core records before 2014",
            "Student-years with more than one record (mid-year movers)",
            "ZIP codes in ZIP+4 format",
            "Blank ZIP codes",
            "MAP ELA scores carrying the +2000 code",
            "MAP Math scores carrying the +2000 code",
            "MAP test records in 2020",
            "Discipline incidents with missing length",
            "Student-years with more than one enrollment row"),
  n = c(sum(core$currentschoolyear < 2014),
        core %>% count(research_id, currentschoolyear) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow(),
        sum(str_detect(core$zipcode, "-"), na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(is.na(core$zipcode) | core$zipcode == ""),
        sum(test$map_score1 >= 2000, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(test$map_score2 >= 2000, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(test$currentschoolyear == 2020),
        sum(is.na(disc$lengthremoved)),
        enroll %>% count(research_id, currentschoolyear) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow())
) %>% kable()
```

## Where do students live?

The study area is St. Louis City and County. ZIPs outside it (Kansas City `641xx`, Columbia `652xx`, Springfield `658xx`) are dropped in cleaning.

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
core %>%
  mutate(zip3 = str_sub(zipcode, 1, 3)) %>%
  count(zip3, name = "records") %>%
  mutate(area = case_when(is.na(zip3) | zip3 == "" ~ "Missing ZIP",
                          zip3 %in% c("630", "631") ~ "St. Louis area",
                          TRUE ~ "Out of area")) %>%
  kable()
```
